correctness.rationale: Every face of Δ_{n,k} fixes disjoint I,J coordinates at 1,0; positive-dimensional free remainder has m=n−a−b, 0<r=k−a<m. The stabilizer S_I×S_J×S_M preserves both the face and excluded-vertex hull, so averaging closest pairs reduces to the symmetric face point and outsider characterized by total fixed-one loss s and fixed-zero gain v. Every outsider vertex violates at least one fixed coordinate, hence s+v>=1. Squared distance is s²/a+v²/b+(s−v)²/m, with empty-group terms omitted. Strict convexity and homogeneity reduce minimization to s+v=1; its minimizer s=a(m+2b)/[m(a+b)+4ab], v=b(m+2a)/[...] yields n/[m(a+b)+4ab]. Both (1,0) and (0,1) rays are attained by actual one-swap outside vertices whenever relevant, making the relaxation exact. Vertex face case separately gives n/[k(n−k)]. For n>=3 maximize D(a,b)=n(a+b)−(a−b)² over nonvertex faces: increasing in a gives a=q−1, then integer concavity in b gives breakpoint n=4q−1 and D pieces exactly as claimed. Vertex bound never lower; n=3 ties, n=2 is segment sqrt2. Independently checked 2,275 exact rational face-type quadratics/optimizer cases through n=15 and n=2 boundary, with code reproduction not extrapolated to arbitrary n.
